purpose: Non-admission scientific source-lineage candidates for European hail modelled swaths, control/future climate simulations, spatially-resampled probabilistic catalogues, ML comparison and radar-based benchmarks.

entries.name: European model-derived hailstorm swaths and storm tracks for present and +3 K climates
entries.provider: ETH Zurich / Killian Brennan, Iris Thurnherr, Michael Sprenger and Heini Wernli
entries.spatial_scope: Europe covered by 2.2 km regional COSMO simulations; spatial domain and exact mask to confirm
entries.temporal_scope: Present-day 2011-2021 forcing and future +3 K pseudo-global-warming case; research publication 2025
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 39,594 present-climate and 37,746 future-climate modelled hail swaths; compressed linked release approximately 0.7 GB; per-storm HAILCAST maximum hail sizes and tracks
entries.note: Brennan et al. (2025), NHESS 25, 3693-3712, DOI 10.5194/nhess-25-3693-2025; tracking code DOI 10.5281/zenodo.12685276. NOT historical measured hail, insurer damage, an IID storm population, or 39,594 independently simulated years. Child tracks depend on the same COSMO simulations as ETH 701925 and 747355 below: not independent model validation. Check exact asset files, stated rights, model calendar, storm/year grouping, masks, climatological frequency, CRS, units and geographic coverage before model use.

entries.name: COSMO 2.2 km hail and lightning present-day simulation selected fields
entries.provider: ETH Zurich / Iris Thurnherr, Ruoyi Cui, Patricio Velasquez and Christoph Schär
entries.spatial_scope: Western to central Europe, rotated model grid; paper describes broader European analysis
entries.temporal_scope: 2011-2021 historical forcing from ERA5; linked Cui et al. 2025 publication
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Selected high-frequency COSMO v6 + CAM-HAILCAST output; simulated maximum hail diameter every 5 min, hourly fields including LPI, rainfall, thermodynamic diagnostics
entries.note: Cui et al. (2025) DOI 10.1029/2024JD042828. Model output (not observed ground hail), driven by ERA5. Spurious hail activation needs published post-processing; LPI is lightning potential, not uncalibrated stroke counts. ETH EURADHAIL DOI 10.3929/ethz-b-000701924 is a separate OPERA-derived observational proxy used for evaluation, not independent of itself. These selected fields are parent data for Brennan modelled swaths, never count the two as separate independent event populations.

entries.name: COSMO +3 °C pseudo-global-warming European hail simulation selected fields
entries.provider: ETH Zurich / Iris Thurnherr, Ruoyi Cui, Patricio Velasquez and Christoph Schär
entries.spatial_scope: Western and central Europe under the 2.2 km COSMO simulation grid
entries.temporal_scope: 2085-2095 model years, constructed via +3 °C pseudo-global-warming delta applied to ERA5 2011-2021 forcing
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Selected 5-minute and hourly COSMO model output including maximum hail diameter, precipitation, LPI and meteorological predictors
entries.note: Thurnherr et al. (2025), DOI 10.1029/2025GL114811. Scenario is not a directly observed future forecast nor baseline annual event rate. Same physics/model lineage as 2011-2021 control and Brennan swaths. Preserve time, region, climate scenario and simulation ensembles; do not mix current and future event populations for return-period calibration.

entries.name: Observed-radar-derived hailstorm tracks for Germany France Belgium and Luxembourg
entries.provider: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology / Elody Fluck and Michael Kunz
entries.spatial_scope: Germany, France, Belgium and Luxembourg; not all Europe
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 2D weather radar and lightning composite, 1 km hail potential, convective cell tracks; derived tracks available upon author request
entries.note: Fluck et al. (2021) explicitly say track series require contacting Michael Kunz and French radar composites Météo-France. Open paper under CC BY 4.0 does not license unpublished tracks or original French radar data. German DWD radar upstream available via DWD separately. No source bytes acquired, no commercial-use permission, no insurer claims. Verify acquisition, rights and independence before calibration.

entries.name: 330-year spatially-resampled European hail hazard event set v2
entries.provider: ETH Zurich / Timo Schmid, Valentin Gebhart, David Bresch / Zenodo
entries.spatial_scope: 28 European countries in Zenodo v2 metadata.csv; per-country event files, including DEU and LUX
entries.temporal_scope: Synthetic 330-year spatial resampling from eleven simulated present-day years (2011-2021) and separately +3 °C pseudo-global-warming; Zenodo version v2 published 2025-12-08
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 56 HDF5 .h5 country/scenario files (28 REF and 28 PGW) plus 3.2 kB metadata.csv; 2.2 km model grid; 19.9 GB total archive, linked CLIMADA data API
entries.note: Schmid et al., Climate Services 41 (2026), 100630, DOI 10.1016/j.cliser.2025.100630. Original Zenodo v2 lists metadata.csv publisher md5 6b6b1d4ec919f56ded7669da3f3b2b82; Germany REF hail_DEU_ref.h5 md5 d4fdbacb9f68af041190a869cfb0cf8d (916.6 MB), PGW hail_DEU_PGW.h5 md5 28f4054eaa7b62eb6468061741f13fe1 (921.2 MB); Luxembourg REF hail_LUX_ref.h5 md5 1d66d63e84d44565c35461c0b8457a57 (8.3 MB), PGW hail_LUX_PGW.h5 md5 2f92c82a25f73e33f93e494abbc2a610 (5.6 MB). Release has published checksums only: NO bytes downloaded or independently hashed. The 330 years are spatial resampling of eleven simulation years, NOT 330 independent weather years or observations. Same simulation parent as COSMO and Brennan swaths; countries can share physical storm parents and CANNOT be concatenated as independent totals. Climate PGW kept separate. License of exact archive HDF5 not yet verified; model NOT_ADMITTED.

entries.name: European XGBoost versus HAILCAST hail projections model-output comparison
entries.provider: Marco Chericoni, Giorgia Fosser, Alessandro Anav, Iris Thurnherr and Andreas F. Prein / Zenodo
entries.spatial_scope: Europe, same COSMO 2.2 km domain for present and +3 °C pseudo-global-warming
entries.temporal_scope: Eleven simulation years 2011-2021 plus +3 °C counterfactual; published 2026-05-08
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Derived XGBoost and HAILCAST hail output from same parent COSMO simulations; exact release files, spatial structure and units to inspect
entries.note: Chericoni et al. (2026), npj Natural Hazards, DOI 10.1038/s44304-026-00218-3. XGBoost trained on ERA5 hail environment versus physically based online HAILCAST yields divergent future hail trends because warmer-climate inputs can be out of training distribution. This is a method comparison on the SAME COSMO simulations, not a second independent 11-year catalogue. Companion code at github.com/marcochericoni95/hail_xgboost_hailcast_ncc; model XGBoost at github.com/borusseee/XGBoost_hail. Dataset rights and exact bytes pending. Do NOT blend model outputs into independent events or use as calibrated building-loss vulnerability.
